_comment: Feature commit SHAs in jlsm repo. feature_sha is the commit containing the TDD work. parent_sha is the state before TDD (end of planning). For state reconstruction: git checkout parent_sha gives the starting point for both standard TDD replay and aTDD comparison.

block-compression.commit_msg: feat(sstable): add block-level compression to SSTable storage

encrypt-memory-data.commit_msg: feat(table): add field-level encryption with searchable encryption support
encrypt-memory-data.note: This session also produced extract-core-encryption, fix-encryption-performance, and ope-type-aware-bounds as follow-on features

engine-clustering.commit_msg: feat(engine): implement engine clustering — membership, ownership, scatter-gather

float16-vector-support.commit_msg: integrating vallorcine and testing float16 support
float16-vector-support.note: Early feature, pre-vallorcine feature pipeline. Merged as PR #7.

in-process-database-engine.commit_msg: feat(engine): add jlsm-engine module with in-process database engine

optimize-document-serializer.commit_msg: perf(table): optimize DocumentSerializer deserialization allocation strategy

sql-query-support.commit_msg: feat(jlsm-sql): add SQL SELECT parser and translator module

streaming-block-decompression.commit_msg: perf(sstable): stream block decompression during v2 compressed scans

striped-block-cache.commit_msg: feat(cache): add StripedBlockCache for multi-threaded performance

table-indices-and-queries.commit_msg: feat(jlsm-table): add secondary indices and fluent query API

vector-field-type.commit_msg: feat(table): add VectorType to FieldType hierarchy with fixed dimensions
